meta.title: Gym Platform
meta.description: Memberships, check-in, classes and trainers for multi-branch gyms.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.notAllowed: You do not have access to this page.

public.heroTitle: Your gym, every branch, one platform.
public.heroBody: Prepaid memberships in ETB, QR check-in, class booking and trainer schedules — built for gyms in Ethiopia.

member.cardBody: Your QR check-in card and membership status will appear here.
member.installHint: Tip: add this app to your home screen from your browser menu.
member.sampleNote: Sample pass. Your own bib appears here once member sign-in opens.
member.photoAlt: A member holding a phone at the gym entrance turnstile

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose where we send renewal reminders, payment approvals and class updates.
notifications.telegramHelp: Open our Telegram bot and press Start to link your account.
notifications.telegramUnavailable: The gym has not set up its Telegram bot yet.
notifications.whatsappHelp: We will message this WhatsApp number.
notifications.whatsappInvalid: Enter a 9-digit Ethiopian mobile number, e.g. 911 234 567.
notifications.savedLocally: Saved on this device. It will sync to your account once sign-in is available.

desk.title: Front desk
desk.body: Check-in by QR or search, live member pop-ups, desk sales and payment approvals.

admin.title: Administration
admin.body: Branches, staff, plans and pricing, VAT settings, reports.

trainer.title: Trainer portal
trainer.body: Your classes, personal-training clients and attendance.

auth.organizationHint: The short name your gym signed up with, e.g. lion-fitness
auth.forgotIntro: We will send a 6-digit code to the Telegram account linked to your profile.
auth.photoAlt: A receptionist at a gym front desk holding a tablet

staffPage.title: Staff
staffPage.name: Full name
staffPage.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Share it privately; they can change it later.

settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.pricesInclusiveHelp: On: the listed price is what members pay and tax is shown inside it. Off: tax is added on top at checkout.
settingsPage.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change these settings.

account.title: My account
account.name: Name
account.telegramLinked: Linked. Codes and notifications arrive in Telegram.
account.telegramNotLinked: Not linked. Link Telegram to reset your password yourself.
account.telegramLinkHelp: Telegram opened in a new tab. Press Start in the bot, then come back and check.

trainerPage.comingUp: Your classes and personal-training clients appear here from Milestone 8.

deskPage.comingUp: QR check-in and live member pop-ups arrive in Milestone 4.
deskPage.scanBody: Scan a member's bib or search by name. Their photo, plan and days left will pop up here.
deskPage.findHint: Type a name, phone or bib number.

adminPage.intro: Manage branches, staff and settings for {organization}.
adminPage.lanesHint: Opening hours on one clock, Addis Ababa time. The line is now.
adminPage.setupTelegram: Link your Telegram so you can reset your own password
adminPage.setupStaff: Add your managers, receptionists and trainers

landing.lede: Memberships in birr, QR check-in at the door, Telebirr approvals and Telegram reminders. One system for every branch you run.
landing.startNote: Set up your first branch in a few minutes.
landing.bibCaption: Sample member pass. Members show it at the door.
landing.lanesLabel: People inside right now, by branch
landing.lanesCaption: Sample data. Your branches appear here once members check in.
landing.momentsTitle: From the door to the books
landing.doorBody: A member shows their bib. The desk sees their photo, plan and days left the moment it scans, and lets them in with one tap.
landing.payBody: Members upload the receipt. Staff approve it in one tap, and a reused FT number is refused automatically.
landing.tgBody: Renewal reminders, payment approvals and one-time codes arrive where your members already are, in Amharic or English.
landing.tgMessage: Selam Hana! Your monthly membership at Bole ends in 3 days. Renew in the app or at the desk.
landing.localTitle: Built for Addis, not adapted to it
landing.localBirr: Prices in birr, with 15% VAT on or off per gym
landing.localLang: Amharic and English, switchable on every screen
landing.localBranches: Owners see every branch; staff see only their own
landing.closeTitle: Put your gym on the track.
landing.closeBody: Start with one branch. Add the next when you open it.
landing.dawnTitle: Your members start at dawn. So does your front desk.
landing.dawnAlt: Four runners on a eucalyptus-lined dirt road on Entoto hill at sunrise
landing.trainingAlt: A trainer coaching a member through a kettlebell swing in an Addis Ababa gym
landing.ogAlt: Three runners on a red running track, seen from above

register.title: Start your gym
register.intro: Create your gym, its first branch and your owner account.
register.gymIdHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Staff type this when they sign in.

members.title: Members
members.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, phone or member number
members.empty: No members yet. Register the first one to give them a bib number.
members.phoneHint: Family members may share one phone.
members.notesHint: Injuries, preferences. Members never see this.
members.photoHint: Shown at the desk when the member checks in.
members.confirmDuplicate: Register anyway: they share this phone
members.noGroup: Not in a couple, family or company group.
members.groupHint: Members in a couple, family or company group get that discount offered automatically at the desk.
members.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Their profile and photo are hidden; the activity log keeps the record.
members.notFound: This member does not exist or was deleted.
members.readOnly: You can view this member but not change them.

pricing.title: Plans & prices
pricing.description: What members can buy, what it costs, and who gets a discount.
pricing.readOnly: Only the owner can change prices.
pricing.plansEmpty: No plans yet. Start with a monthly membership.
pricing.archiveConfirm: Stop selling {name}? Members who bought it keep their membership.
pricing.amHint: Optional. Shown when the app is in Amharic.

typeHints.time: Unlimited visits for a number of days.
typeHints.visits: A number of visits with no expiry.
typeHints.time_visits: A number of visits that expire after some days.

pricing.taxInclusive: Includes {name} {rate}%: set the price members pay.
pricing.taxExclusive: {name} {rate}% is added on top at the desk.
pricing.taxOff: Tax is off. Change it in Settings.
pricing.freezeHint: Freezing arrives in a later milestone; the rules are kept with each sale.
pricing.registrationHint: Added to a member's first membership. The desk can remove it.

kindHints.student: The desk checks a student ID before giving it.
kindHints.couple: Offered to members in a couple group.
kindHints.family: Offered to members in a family group.
kindHints.corporate: Offered to members in a company group.
kindHints.promo: Applies when the desk types the code.

sale.title: Sell a membership
sale.renewalNote: Their current membership runs to {date}, so this one starts the day after.
sale.noPlanHint: No membership, just the fees below.
sale.partNote: Part payment: {amount} will still be owed and the membership waits until it is paid.
sale.slipHint: Optional. Stops the same slip being recorded twice.
sale.laterNote: The invoice stays open. The membership starts once it is paid.
sale.nothing: Pick a plan or a fee.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.voidHint: Payments are marked refunded and any membership on it is cancelled. The number stays used.
